Today's Mailbag


We constantly get questions from readers, viewers, listeners, and others about how we got our jobs at CNET. I got mine by getting laid off from TechTV But of course there's more to the story than that.  You have to some experience, education, and so on. Molly Wood takes on this burning question as well as several others in today's episode of CNET Mailbag. Your questions are answered frankly and we hope, entertainingly. How *do* you get a job at CNET?
